crossRefs.note: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done…
He dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city.…
These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all…

translations.web: He fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil and wine.
translations.bsb: He strengthened their fortifications and put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.
translations.kjv: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
translations.asv: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of victuals, and oil and wine.
